banner.subtitle: To, Cc, Bcc, reply-all, templates, drafts and approval.

sections.title: Advanced Email Composer for Odoo
sections.tagline: Send real emails from the chatter.
sections.subtitle: A Send email button next to Send message. One genuine email goes to the people you choose, and nobody else gets a notification.

sections.flow_alt: Open a record, click Send email, optionally get approval, one real email is sent
sections.html: Send message is a discussion: it can email every follower, one by one. Send email is a letter: one email, to the To, Cc and Bcc you pick. Follow the screenshots to see how it works.

items.title: Inline form
items.text: Opens in the chatter. No popup.

items.title: Reply all by default
items.text: The right people, and the old email quoted.

items.title: Templates
items.text: Fill recipients, subject and text in one click.

items.title: Drafts

sections.title: Send email, right in the chatter
sections.alt: A contact form with the chatter on the right, showing the Send email form with To, Cc, subject and body
sections.intro: On a wide screen the chatter sits beside the record. Send email opens in it, with the other emails of the record in a list below. The next screenshots show each step on a narrower screen.

sections.title: 1. Emails stand out in the thread
sections.alt: A thread with received and sent emails, each with a badge, From, To, Cc and Reply, Reply all, Forward buttons
sections.intro: A badge, From, To and Cc, then Reply, Reply all and Forward right under them.

sections.title: 2. Start from a template
sections.alt: A new email filled from a template: To, Bcc, subject and body, with the signature below
sections.intro: Click Send email, pick a template. Recipients, subject and text are filled for this record. Your signature stays.

sections.title: 3. Find people as you type
sections.alt: The Cc field with a suggestion list while typing a name
sections.intro: Suggestions from users, contacts and addresses you used before. Cc and Bcc show up only when you need them.

sections.title: 4. Reply all in one click
sections.alt: A reply with To and Cc filled, the signature and the quoted original email
sections.intro: The right people in To and Cc, an RE: subject, three empty lines to write in, and the previous email quoted.

sections.title: 5. Drafts save themselves
sections.alt: A draft with a pasted image in the body and the list of unsent emails below
sections.intro: Paste an image and it just works. Unfinished emails are kept in a list under the form.

sections.title: 6. Ask for approval
sections.alt: The request approval dialog with an approver and a note
sections.intro: Pick one or more approvers, add a note. Anyone of them can approve.

sections.title: 7. Wait for the answer
sections.alt: An email waiting for approval, with the names of the approvers
sections.intro: The email shows who must approve. You can keep editing; the approver sees the latest text.

sections.title: 8. The approver decides
sections.alt: The approver's page with the email, the request and the Approve, Reject and Reassign buttons
sections.intro: One click to Approve and send, Reject or Reassign.

sections.title: 9. Rejected? Fix it and ask again
sections.alt: A rejected email with the reason given by the approver
sections.intro: The reason is shown on the email. Edit it and ask again.

items.title: Approval flow
items.text: Off: everybody sends right away. On: every email is approved first.

items.title: Self approval
items.text: Allow it or not. Allowed by default.

items.title: Who approves
items.text: Pick the people. Empty means every internal user.

items.title: Who skips approval
items.text: Pick the people who still see Send now. The administrator by default.

items.title: Clean up
items.text: Unfinished emails are deleted after 180 days. You choose the number.

items.title: Enforced by the server
items.text: Hiding a button is not enough: the rules are checked when the email is sent.

sections.title: Set the rules
sections.alt: The Email Composer entry of the settings: approval flow, self approval, approvers, who can send without approval and the number of days to keep unfinished emails
sections.intro: Its own entry in Settings, like any app. The options under Approval flow appear only when it is on.

sections.title: Two ways to send
sections.alt: The Send email menu with the Send now and Request approval and send choices
sections.intro: People who can send without approval get a menu: Send now or Request approval.

sections.title: One way to send
sections.alt: The email form with a single Request approval button and the note that an approver must approve
sections.intro: Everybody else gets one button. With the approval flow on, it is Request approval. With the flow off, it is Send email.

sections.title: Requirements & Installation
sections.intro: Needs the standard mail module and the free dwo_mail_bcc (installed with it). No external library.
notes: For internal users only. Portal and public users cannot use the composer.

blocks.html: 1. Copy the dwo_mail_bcc and dwo_mail_compose folders into an add-ons path of your Odoo server.
2. Restart Odoo, activate developer mode and click Update Apps List in the Apps menu.
3. Search for Advanced Email Composer and click Install. Mail BCC Support is installed with it.
Reload your browser page after installing so the new assets are loaded.
Open a record, click Send email, fill in the recipients and the message, then use Send now. Use Advanced to add a Reply-To address.
Choose Request approval and send, pick one or more approvers (yourself included) and add an optional note. Approvers find the request in Discuss > Email Approvals.
Any one approver is enough to send; any one rejection is enough to stop. The email is sent from your address with your rights.
Approval flow: off, the Send email button sends right away and there is no approval. On, every email is approved first.
Allow approving your own emails (flow on): on by default. Off, you cannot choose yourself as approver.
Approvers (flow on): the people who can be chosen. Leave it empty and every internal user can approve.
Can send without approval (flow on): these people always see Send now. The administrator is in the list by default.
An email needs at least one recipient in To; an email with only Cc or Bcc cannot be sent.
Delivery is not tracked per Cc or Bcc address.
Images inside the body are links to your Odoo server, so recipients see them only if the server is reachable from the internet. Use Attach to be sure.
Sending to several records at once, scheduling and preview are not available yet. The interface is in English.

items.q: What is the difference with Send message?
items.a: Send message can email each follower separately. Send email sends one real email to the To, Cc and Bcc you choose, and does not notify followers.

items.q: Do replies come back to the record?
items.a: Yes. The standard message identifiers are kept, so the mail gateway routes the answer to the same record.
Yes. Turn on Approval flow. The server then refuses to send right away, except for the people you list in Can send without approval.

items.q: Can I stop people from approving their own emails?
items.a: Yes. Turn off Allow approving your own emails. You can also limit the approvers to a list of people.
Your own email, the company email and the default sending address.

items.q: Does it need Mail BCC Support?
items.a: Yes, it is free and installed with this module.

sections.headline: Official emails, without leaving Odoo.
sections.text: Install it, open a record and click Send email.
